title: Claim Submission and Remittance Posting for Wound Care Shipments
content:
# Claims and remittances — Wound Care Supply Program

Billing office policy for claims on Wound Care Supply Program shipments.

## Clauses

1. **One original claim per shipment.** Every refill shipped on a payer tier is billed to the payer named by the program's coverage record by one original claim per shipment, with the ship date as the date of service; the Wound Care Self-Pay Program files no claims.
2. **Timely filing.** An original claim must be transmitted no later than the tier's timely filing limit, in calendar days, after the date of service of the shipment it bills, counted in calendar days from that ship date with the last day allowed; a shipment whose filing limit has passed is billed to neither the payer nor the customer and is written off by Larkfield.
3. **Corrected and void claims.** A corrected claim replaces an original claim when the units, item or dates billed were wrong or some of the units were returned, and a void claim withdraws an original claim when all of its units were returned; both reference the same shipment as the original.
4. **Patient responsibility on a remittance.** When a remittance posts, the patient responsibility added to the customer's balance is the allowed amount less the amount the payer paid, which the remittance itemizes as deductible, coinsurance and copay; Larkfield never posts more than that and never bills the customer the difference between its billed charge and the allowed amount on a payer tier.
5. **Secondary coverage.** On tiers where the patient responsibility crosses over to a secondary coverage and the customer has an in-effect secondary coverage record, the patient responsibility is crossed over to the secondary payer, and the secondary payer's payment is posted as a balance adjustment with reason secondary payer payment against that remittance before any amount is statemented; on other tiers a secondary coverage is billed by Larkfield's billing team only after the primary remittance posts.
6. **Medicaid.** On the Wound Care Medicaid Program a customer is never billed for a Medicaid-covered item beyond the patient responsibility the Medicaid remittance shows.

## Timely filing boundary (hypothetical figures)

Ship date 2026-02-10 on a tier with a 90-day limit: a claim transmitted on 2026-05-11 is timely (the last day is allowed); a claim that would be transmitted on 2026-05-12 is past the limit, and the shipment is written off by Larkfield.

## Worked remittance (hypothetical figures)

Billed charge USD 210.00, allowed amount USD 180.00, payer paid USD 144.00. The patient responsibility posted is USD 180.00 less USD 144.00, that is USD 36.00, as itemized on the remittance. The USD 30.00 by which the billed charge exceeds the allowed amount is never billed to the customer.

## Which claim applies

| Event on the shipment | Claim |
|---|---|
| Refill shipped on a payer tier | original claim |
| Units, item or dates billed were wrong | corrected claim |
| Some units returned | corrected claim |
| All units returned | void claim |
